_doc: Language-neutral conformance cases for the provenance law and checker. JS and Python runners load this file and must produce identical results. Keys are camelCase (the canonical envelope shape); the Python runner translates to snake_case. This file — not prose — is the parity contract.

combine.name: a handed envelope with off-ladder values still combines: confidence read as none, source ignored (§2; #443 refuses only at construction)
real + mock — taint, weakest confidence, weakest source, numeric floor
real + semiReal — stays clean, medium confidence, weakest source semiReal
partial numeric coverage — score omitted because one input lacks it
three inputs — taint ORs across all
zero inputs — unavailable (derived-from-nothing), no lineage, no weakest source, no numeric score
inferred + fallback — inferred is the weaker source
content-addressed lineage ids — real + mock, ids are stable sha256 (#52)
content-addressed lineage ids — scored inputs pin the confidenceScore branch of the id hash (#52)
content-addressed lineage ids — sub-1e-4 score exercises the IEEE-754 hex encoding branch (catches JSON.stringify/json.dumps divergence, #52)
a handed confidence true gives the same step id in both languages: a boolean serializes as true/false (#525)
a handed numeric confidence serializes as its IEEE-754 bit pattern, so 1.0 and 1 give one id in both languages (#525)
a handed array or object confidence, or a boolean source, serializes by type (<array>, <object>, false), the same in both languages; the unknown source omits weakestSource (#525; #551)
an input that is not an envelope (a string, a number, a boolean, an array, null) combines in both languages: its step records source and confidence as null (#525)
a source or confidence the input carries as null, or lacks, is recorded as null, so the step always has both keys (#525)

prior lineage steps that are not objects are kept verbatim, an array as an array, and only string ids feed the new step's id; those steps have no known source, so weakestSource is omitted (#525; #551)
a lineage that is not an array contributes no prior steps, in both languages (#525)
a derivedFromMock that is not a boolean is not read as taint: combine keeps it on the step as it is, so the guard refuses the result as invalid, never as mock (§3; #555, reversing #525)
a derivedFromMock of null counts as absent and does not taint (§3; #525)
a number beyond double range serializes as infinity in both languages: a 400-digit integer and 1e400 give one id (#525 review)
negative zero serializes as zero, in a field and in the score: -0 and 0 give one id in both languages (#525 review)
a lone surrogate in a handed field hashes as U+FFFD in both languages (#525 review)
input ids are sorted by code point in both languages, so a non-BMP id sorts after U+FFFF (#525 review)
a known and an unknown-source input: weakestSource is omitted, not read off the known one alone (#551)

audit.name: consistent derived value — no issues
laundering — clean source with taint set
ordinal over-claiming — confidence above weakest lineage
numeric over-claiming — confidenceScore above weakest lineage score
source over-claim — weakestSource cleaner than lineage proves
dropped taint — tainted lineage step but derivedFromMock false
unreproducible — derived source with empty lineage
zero-input combine output — unavailable with empty lineage audits clean (SPEC §3 ↔ §5)
null envelope — missing meta
empty envelope — no issues besides the version-legacy advisory (#93: absent version is legacy)
non-dict meta (falsy scalar) — missing meta (totality, SPEC §5)
truthy non-dict meta (string) — missing meta (parity, not an envelope)
truthy non-dict meta (array) — missing meta (parity)
version-legacy — envelope without a version is flagged legacy
version-future — newer version passes with an advisory
version-malformed — a fractional version is not an integer (#216; SPEC §5b carries an integer — this was routed to version-future while merely finite)
version-malformed — a fractional version below current is not an integer either (#216; was version-legacy: 'predates version 2' said of 1.5)
integral float is an integer version (#216: JSON has no int/float distinction — 2.0 parses float in Python and number in JS; value integrality, not type, decides)
version-malformed — explicit null is not a version (#156; was the JS/Python divergence: JS silent, Python legacy)
version-malformed — a numeric string is not a version (#156)
version-malformed — a list is not a version (#156)
version-malformed — an object is not a version (#156)
version-malformed — a boolean is not a version (JS typeof and Python isinstance both had to exclude it explicitly) (#156)
inferred source is not laundering — no issue on a clean inferred value

a lineage step whose derivedFromMock is not a boolean ([] or 0) is not read as tainted, so the audit names it as malformed, not as dropped taint; the guard refuses such a step as invalid (§3; #555; #551)
expectContains: malformed taint flag: lineage step 0 derivedFromMock is not a boolean

audit.name: only a boolean true taints: a lineage step whose derivedFromMock is the string "true" is malformed, not tainted, so the audit names it as malformed, not as dropped taint (§3; #555; #551)
expectContains: malformed taint flag: lineage step 0 derivedFromMock is not a boolean

audit.name: a lineage step with a null source is named as an unknown source, not read as clean (#551)
expectContains: unknown source: lineage step 0 has no source

audit.name: a lineage step with no source key is named as an unknown source (#551)
expectContains: unknown source: lineage step 0 has no source

audit.name: a lineage step whose source is off the ladder is named as an unknown source (#551)
expectContains: unknown source: lineage step 0 source is not on the source ladder

audit.name: a lineage step that is not an object is named: its source is unknown (#551)
expectContains: unknown source: lineage step 0 is not an object

audit.name: a relabelled derived value is a source over-claim: source 'real' above weakestSource 'fallback' (#556)
expectContains: source over-claim: source 'real' is cleaner than its ancestry's weakest source 'fallback'

audit.name: a derived value over a fallback input is not an over-claim: derived is the law's own label (#556)
a leaf whose weakestSource is cleaner than its own source, with no lineage to show it, is a source over-claim (#553)
expectContains: source over-claim: weakestSource 'real' is cleaner than source 'fallback', with no lineage to show it

audit.name: a derive of a derive of real data relabelled real is not an over-claim: a floor of derived is the law's own label, as in the one-level case (#556 review)
a handed relabel with no weakestSource is still caught from the lineage: source real over a fallback step (#556 review)
expectContains: source over-claim: source 'real' is cleaner than its ancestry's weakest source 'fallback'

audit.name: a stated weakestSource over a lineage with an unknown source cannot be shown (#551 review)
expectContains: source over-claim: weakestSource 'real' cannot be shown: a lineage step's source is unknown
unknown source: lineage step 1 has no source

audit.name: real over a lineage of derived steps alone is an over-claim: no real data is shown, as when a value re-marked derived had its lineage dropped (#551 verification)
expectContains: source over-claim: source 'real' is cleaner than its ancestry's weakest source 'derived'

audit.name: a leaf stating weakestSource derived under a real source is an over-claim: it shows no real data (#551 verification)
expectContains: source over-claim: source 'real' is cleaner than its ancestry's weakest source 'derived'

audit.name: a relabel the known steps prove is named even when another step is unknown (#551 verification)
expectContains: source over-claim: source 'real' is cleaner than its ancestry's weakest source 'fallback'
unknown source: lineage step 1 has no source

validate.name: complete envelope — all four required fields present and well-typed
complete envelope with optional fields and populated lineage — valid
empty envelope — all four required fields missing
wrong type — lineage is not an array
wrong type — derivedFromMock is not a boolean
non-object envelope — not an envelope at all

construct.name: an in-ladder source and confidence construct an envelope
a numeric confidence is refused at construction (#443; the remediate skill once taught confidence: 0)
construct.expectError: confidence must be one of none, low, medium, high

construct.name: a confidence outside the ladder is refused, case-sensitively (#443)
construct.expectError: confidence must be one of none, low, medium, high

construct.name: a null confidence is refused, not defaulted (#443)
construct.expectError: confidence must be one of none, low, medium, high

construct.name: a source outside STATUS is refused at construction (#443)
construct.expectError: source must be one of unavailable, mock, inferred, fallback, semiReal, derived, real

construct.name: a non-string source is refused at construction (#443)
construct.expectError: source must be one of unavailable, mock, inferred, fallback, semiReal, derived, real

construct.name: a null source is refused, not defaulted (#443)
construct.expectError: source must be one of unavailable, mock, inferred, fallback, semiReal, derived, real

construct.name: an empty confidence is refused (#443)
construct.expectError: confidence must be one of none, low, medium, high

construct.name: with both off the ladder, source is reported first (#443)
construct.expectError: source must be one of unavailable, mock, inferred, fallback, semiReal, derived, real

construct.name: an omitted source is refused, not defaulted: a leaf declares where it came from (#177)
construct.expectError: source is required (one of unavailable, mock, inferred, fallback, semiReal, derived, real)

construct.name: an empty input is refused for its missing source (#177)
construct.expectError: source is required (one of unavailable, mock, inferred, fallback, semiReal, derived, real)

construct.name: an omitted confidence still defaults to none (#177 changes source only)
a non-boolean derivedFromMock is refused at construction ([]), as an off-ladder rung is (ADR-0019; #555)
a null derivedFromMock counts as absent, so a mock leaf defaults to tainted, in both languages (§3; #525 review)
a derivedFromMock of "false" is refused at construction, even on a mock leaf, not read as clean or as mock (#555)
a derivedFromMock of 0 on a real leaf is refused at construction (#555)
a null basis or adapter is no field: an optional field with no value is absent (SPEC §1, #566)
a null confidenceScore is no field (#566)

derive.name: a null confidenceScore override keeps the combined score (#566)
a null basis or adapter override writes no field (#566)
no override leaves the law's result (#566)
a null source override is refused, not read as unset (#443)
a null confidence override is refused, not read as unset (#443)

guard.name: a clean real value passes the defaults
a mock leaf is refused by default: no-mock is on unless turned off (P4)
a mock leaf passes when no-mock is turned off
a value derived from mock is refused by default
with no-mock off, a minimum confidence still applies
expectRefused: confidence: low is below the required medium

guard.name: a clean value at the minimum confidence passes
a clean value below the minimum confidence is refused
expectRefused: confidence: medium is below the required high

guard.name: confidence is judged from the lineage, not the headline field
expectRefused: confidence: low is below the required medium

guard.name: taint in the lineage is refused even when the headline flag says clean
an inconsistent envelope is refused even with no-mock off
a value with no envelope is refused
null is refused as not a marked value
a list is refused as not a marked value
an empty envelope is refused as malformed
expectRefused: invalid envelope: missing required field: source

guard.name: a wrongly typed field is refused as malformed
expectRefused: invalid envelope: field 'confidence' must be a string

guard.name: an envelope from a newer version passes on its content: a future version is advisory (SPEC §5b)
an envelope with no version field passes: legacy is advisory, not a refusal
a confidence off the ladder is refused as malformed, whatever the options
a minimum confidence of none admits any confidence
a minimum confidence off the ladder is a programmer error, not a refusal
guard.expectError: guard: the minimum confidence must be one of none, low, medium, high

guard.name: a non-boolean no-mock option is a programmer error, not a refusal
guard.expectError: guard: the no-mock option must be a boolean

guard.name: a weakest source of mock is refused even when nothing else shows taint
a derived step carrying taint is refused, the shape derive() builds
a malformed version field is refused
a source off the ladder is refused as malformed
a weakest source off the ladder is refused as malformed
a lineage step that is not a plain object is refused as malformed
a lineage step that is a bare string is refused as malformed
a lineage step whose taint flag is not a boolean is refused as malformed
a lineage step with no confidence counts as none against a minimum
expectRefused: confidence: none is below the required low

guard.name: an unknown option is a programmer error, so a misspelt option cannot leave a check at its default
a minimum confidence that is not a string is a programmer error
guard.expectError: guard: the minimum confidence must be one of none, low, medium, high

guard.name: a lineage step whose source is off the ladder is refused as malformed, so its taint cannot hide
a lineage step whose confidence is off the ladder is refused as malformed
every structural issue is reported, a wrong type beside a missing field
expectRefused: invalid envelope: field 'source' must be a string
invalid envelope: missing required field: derivedFromMock
invalid envelope: missing required field: lineage

guard.name: a confidence score that is not a number in [0, 1] is refused as malformed
a confidence score above one is refused as malformed
a lineage step whose confidence score is not a number is refused, so an over-claim cannot hide behind it
a lineage step whose confidence score is above one is refused as malformed
a lineage step that is not a plain object names that fact
expectRefused: invalid envelope: lineage step 0 is not a plain object

guard.name: a lineage step with no source is refused: with no rung to degrade to, it cannot be shown not to be mock (fail closed; a missing confidence counts as none instead; #525 review)
expectRefused: invalid envelope: lineage step 0 has no source

guard.name: a relabelled derived value is refused through the audit: source 'real' over a fallback ancestry (#556)
expectRefused: audit: source over-claim: source 'real' is cleaner than its ancestry's weakest source 'fallback'

guard.name: the source floor is off by default: a fallback leaf passes (#541)
a fallback leaf below a semiReal floor is refused, as a source, not as mock (#541)
expectRefused: source: fallback is below the required semiReal

guard.name: an inferred leaf below a fallback floor is refused (#541)
expectRefused: source: inferred is below the required fallback

guard.name: a real leaf at a real floor passes (#541)
the floor reads the ancestry, not the headline: a derive over fallback is refused below semiReal (#541)
expectRefused: source: fallback is below the required semiReal

guard.name: derived is the law's own label, skipped by the floor: a derive of a derive of real data passes a real floor (#541)
with no-mock off, a floor above mock still refuses mock, as a source (#541)
expectRefused: source: mock is below the required inferred

guard.name: the floor and no-mock both report a mock ancestry (#541)
expectRefused: mock: the value derives from mock data
source: mock is below the required fallback

guard.name: an unknown minimum source is a TypeError, not a refusal (#541)
guard.expectError: guard: the minimum source must be one of unavailable, mock, inferred, fallback, semiReal, derived, real

guard.name: with nothing but derived labels in the ancestry, no source shows the floor is met, so it is refused (#541)
expectRefused: source: no source in the ancestry shows it meets the required inferred
